import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

q = int(data[0])
index = 1
results = []

for _ in range(q):
    n = int(data[index])
    k = int(data[index + 1])
    s = data[index + 2]
    index += 3
    
    if k == 1:
        results.append("YES\n0")
        continue
    
    # Create a dictionary to store the positions of each character in the first k-1 characters
    pos = {0: [], 1: []}
    for i in range(k - 1):
        pos[int(s[i])].append(i)
    
    # Initialize the beautiful string with all zeros
    t = [0] * k
    
    # Check each possible starting position for the beautiful string
    for start in range(n - k + 1):
        # Update the positions of the last character in the current window
        last_char = int(s[start + k - 1])
        pos[last_char].append(start + k - 1)
        
        # Check if the current beautiful string is bit similar to the current window
        found = False
        for i in range(k):
            if t[i] in pos:
                found = True
                break
        
        if not found:
            # If not, update the beautiful string to be bit similar to the current window
            for i in range(k):
                if i in pos:
                    t[i] = 1
                    break
        
        # Remove the positions of the first character in the current window
        first_char = int(s[start])
        pos[first_char].remove(start)
    
    # Convert the beautiful string to a string
    t_str = ''.join(map(str, t))
    
    # Check if the beautiful string is bit similar to all windows
    for start in range(n - k + 1):
        if all(t[i] != int(s[start + i]) for i in range(k)):
            results.append("NO")
            break
    else:
        results.append("YES\n" + t_str)

# Print all results
print('\n'.join(results))
